title: douyin-carousel-generator script
description: A shot script for one Douyin two-panel explainer-comic carousel. Feed it to `python -m dig render --script <file>`. Run `python -m dig validate --script <file>` first: it enforces rules this schema cannot express, such as caption length and duplicate detection.

theme.description: The single theme the whole set covers, in one sentence.

title.description: Post title, 10-18 Chinese characters. Says what the viewer will be able to do after watching.

hook.description: First line of the post copy: what this set teaches, in one sentence.

caption.description: Post body, 2-4 lines, colloquial. Names the source if there is one, restates the single most useful instruction, ends by asking viewers to save it.

source.description: Where the idea comes from: book title plus the specific idea, e.g. 《穷查理宝典》· 逆向思维. Pick from the source library in prompts/topic_ideation_zh.md. Printed in caption.txt for the operator; never drawn into the art.

style_id.description: Preset id from styles/. Wins unless --style is passed on the CLI.

character_id.description: A character registered via `dig character add`. Honoured by validate, render and reroll alike; if it is not registered on this machine they stop before spending. Use `character` instead for mascots.

character.description: Inline protagonist. No photo, no registration. Strongly recommended: without one the character changes on every panel.

sheet.description: Appearance, 60+ Chinese characters: face, hair, eyes, usual outfit, signature accessory. Injected into every panel prompt.

signature.description: 1-2 anchor elements that must appear in every panel, e.g. 红围巾 + 圆眼镜.

style_refs.description: Per-style key art, {style_id: path}. Written by `dig character stylize`; a style only ever uses its own entry.

pages.description: 5-7 is the working range for this format.

beats.description: Keep this count identical on every page. 2 is the reference format.

caption.description: The banner line drawn onto the panel. 5-14 Chinese characters, usually 9-13. Plain counsel that works on its own: the situation plus what to do, in everyday words, e.g. 刚入行，先把基本功练扎实. Someone who sees only this image must understand it, so no book terms, metaphors or label prefixes like 潜龙期：. No questions, no teasers, no serial numbers. Must be unique across the set, and the same shape as the others.

scene.description: What to draw: who + where + doing what + mood, 30-60 Chinese characters. Show the protagonist (主角) carrying out this panel's instruction. Never ask for text, signs, lettering or 《book titles》 in the image.

note.description: Voice-over note: why this advice works. This is where the book's own term goes (潜龙勿用：…). Not rendered.

image.description: Written by the tool: this panel's art, relative to the script's folder. Leave it out of hand-written scripts.

variant.description: Written by `dig reroll`: how many times this panel was redrawn. Each redraw gets a new cache key and seed.
